experiment: W2.3 candidate chains: Cypher on Neo4j vs Yen's algorithm in Python
note: Real queries on the live graph, demo routes only; the demo vehicles' chargers and reports are simulated.
cypher: MATCH p = (:RoadSegment {id: $start})-[legs:LEG*1..6 {scope: $scope, soc_band: $band}]->(:RoadSegment {id: $end}) WHERE none(n IN nodes(p)[1..-1] WHERE n.id IN $banned) WITH [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS chain, reduce(c = 0.0, l IN legs | c + l.minutes + $w * coalesce($fail[startNode(l).id], 0.0)) AS cost RETURN chain, cost ORDER BY cost, chain LIMIT $k
reading: One dispatch makes three chain queries (cheapest, reliability-weighted, spatially distinct).
